body:
## Purpose
A review of every change since the fork (S-5 to S-8) found one bug, some stale text, and two open product questions. This spec collects the fixes so the branch can go up as one clean PR.

## Requirements
1. Bug: the attached menu bar window's frame (960 x 640) is recorded as the main window size (`observe_window_bounds` -> `quick_note::remember`), and saved on quit. After one menu bar session, Open in Window and the standalone window open at the popover size instead of the size the user last chose. Fix: do not remember the size while attached, and have detach use this session's remembered size, not only the saved one.
2. Docs: `docs/FORMAT.md` still names `~/Documents/Quiet.md`, `QUIET_MD_HOME` and the `quiet-md/recovery` folder; `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` the recovery folder. Update to `~/Documents/Quill`, `QUILL_HOME`, `quill/recovery`.
3. README: drop the line saying the name, icon and Nucleo icons must still be replaced (S-6 did that).
4. Stale comments about Windows/Linux in src/app.rs, src/local_files.rs, src/logging.rs (code already removed by D-1).
5. Version and changelog, per the version question.
6. Dock icon after the standalone window is closed, per the Dock question.

## Out of scope
New features. Upstream docs under docs/upstream stay as they are.

## Acceptance checks
- Show from the menu bar, quit, relaunch, Open in Window: the window opens at the last standalone size, not 960 x 640.
- grep for Quiet.md / QUIET_MD in docs/*.md finds only attribution.
- check.sh passes.

## Not verified yet (from S-6 to S-8, listed for the record)
- Quill next to an installed Quiet.md (checked in code only; Quiet.md is not installed here).
- S-7 Req 9: a second display and an auto-hidden menu bar (placement handles both in code; only one display here).
- S-8 Req 3: 120 Hz frame timing of the slide was not measured.
